 The Honourable Dr Justice Venkata Jyothirmai Pratapa
 Criminal Petition No: 572/2023

The instant criminal petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C)/under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS') has been filed by the Petitioners/Accused Nos. 2 to 4, seeking quashment of the proceedings pending against them in Crime No.98 of 2022 of Disha UPS, Tirupati, Tirupati District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498- A, 494, 420 & 506 of IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Sri Ramakrishna Akurathi, learned counsel for the petitioners seeks the permission of this Court to withdraw the present petition.
4. Ms.K.Priyanka Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor on behalf of the State is in attendance.
5. In that view, the Criminal Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

_________________________________________ Dr. JUSTICE VENKATA JYOTHIRMAI PRATAPA Date: 08.10.2025 UPS HON'BLE DR.
